title: Secure the Treasury
description: A Treasury should be capable of holding wealth before it becomes impressive enough to justify counting it. Prepare a secured entrance and a dedicated container. There will be no absurd requirement to heap up arbitrary blocks of gold merely so the room can be called restored.
description_completed: The Dark Tower Treasury has the basic secure fittings required to operate as a vault. Accumulated wealth remains an expression of the reign, not a restoration grind.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign
